invented_facts: Windows 11 Pro integrates with Morgan’s existing fleet management tools; neither those tools nor compatibility with them is specified.
The self-healing BIOS protects against firmware attacks; the spec sheet does not make that claim.
The service warranty ensures uptime; no uptime guarantee is provided.
The laptops will ensure productivity on-site; the source does not guarantee that outcome.
notes: The sequence includes three emails and addresses the Q1 deadline, but email 2 focuses on management rather than directly answering why a cloud-first team should also buy powerful laptops. All three emails exceed 120 words, and email 3 has two meeting calls to action.
